text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
The turf... the canvas of my love must be 
far more vivid...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
...Ah, that's right. That lapis lazuli I 
received the other day—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: Perhaps I should grind it into paint.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: Haaah... Either way, today is a no-go.
